items.headline: 年增幅放缓，为何仍创新高？
items.headline_en: A smaller increase can still set a record
items.summary: 10月27日WMO公布：2025年全球地表CO₂平均浓度达426.8ppm，较工业化前高53%。浓度是大气“存量”，不是当年排放量；排放约一半留在大气，其余被陆地和海洋吸收。即使年增幅放缓，存量仍可创新高。
items.summary_en: WMO reported on October 27 that global surface CO₂ concentration reached 426.8 ppm in 2025, 53% above pre-industrial levels. Concentration is an atmospheric stock, not annual emissions. About half of yearly CO₂ emissions remain airborne; land and oceans absorb the rest. A slower annual increase can still produce a record concentration.

items.headline: 越小的火星尘埃，越难甩掉
items.headline_en: Tiny Mars dust is hard to shake off
items.summary: NASA 10月26日报道：毅力号在材料样片上测得细至约100纳米的火星尘埃；最细颗粒多年行驶与钻探后仍附着。静电似乎影响不同表面吸附的粒径。测量可帮助选择宇航服材料与除尘设计；这不是人体暴露试验。
items.summary_en: NASA reported on October 26 that Perseverance measured Mars dust down to about 100 nanometres on material samples. The finest particles remained attached through years of driving and drilling. Static electricity appears to influence which sizes stick to different surfaces. These measurements may guide spacesuit materials and dust removal; they are not human exposure tests.

items.headline: 与木星“同行”的小行星
items.summary: NASA 10月28日宣布，露西号进入木星特洛伊小行星区域。太阳和木星的共同引力，使这些小天体聚集在木星前后两个稳定区域。研究它们可检验太阳系形成理论；首次近距离飞掠特洛伊小行星仍定于2027年8月11日，并未已经抵达目标旁。
items.summary_en: NASA announced on October 28 that Lucy had entered the Jupiter Trojan region. The combined gravity of the Sun and Jupiter keeps these small bodies clustered in two stable regions ahead of and behind Jupiter. Studying them can test solar-system formation theories. The first close Trojan-asteroid flyby remains scheduled for August 11, 2027; it has not happened yet.

items.headline: 有水，为什么仍难定居？
items.summary: 10月28日，研究者报告：阿拉伯沙漠约1500公里调查发现古湖泊，却未找到石器遗物。结合空间模型，结果提示：早期人类定居不仅需要水，也需要能打制工具的石材。迁徙地图因此不能只看气候；未发现遗物，也不等于证明无人到过。
items.summary_en: On October 28, researchers reported ancient lake deposits but no stone artefacts along a roughly 1,500-kilometre Arabian desert survey. Spatial modelling suggests settlement depended on both water and toolmaking stone. Migration maps therefore need geology as well as climate. However, missing archaeological traces do not prove that nobody ever visited.

items.headline: 吸光之后，怎样留住电荷？
items.summary: 10月28日，研究发现硫化铋薄膜既能强烈吸光，又能延缓电子与空穴复合。邻近的低能态像临时“蓄水池”，让电荷不易迅速损失，为收集电荷留下更多时间。这提供了太阳能材料设计新思路，但验证的是物理机制，并非已造出更高效的太阳能电池。
items.summary_en: On October 28, researchers showed that bismuth sulfide films combine strong light absorption with slower electron–hole recombination. Nearby lower-energy states act as a temporary reservoir, giving charges more time to be collected. This suggests a new design principle for solar-energy materials, but demonstrates a physical mechanism, not a finished, more efficient solar cell.

items.headline: 神经回路如何自己打节拍？
items.headline_en: How a neural circuit makes a rhythm
items.summary: 10月28日，果蝇神经连接图模拟锁定一个候选步行节律回路：两个兴奋性神经元与一个抑制性神经元形成反馈，将持续输入变成周期输出。另一条通路的运动预测获得光刺激实验支持。这展示了如何从“接线图”推测功能，但三细胞核心仍是候选机制。
items.summary_en: On October 28, fly-connectome simulations identified a candidate walking rhythm circuit: two excitatory neurons and one inhibitory neuron form feedback that turns sustained input into rhythmic output. Light-stimulation experiments supported a movement prediction for another pathway. Wiring maps can suggest function, while the three-neuron core remains a candidate mechanism.

previous_answers.headline: 5×5方格起初全白。每步可选一整行或一整列，把其中所有格子黑白互换。若最终至少有一个黑格，黑格最少能有几个？给出做法，并证明不能更少。
previous_answers.headline_en: A 5×5 grid starts entirely white. Each move flips every cell in one whole row or column between black and white. If at least one cell ends black, what is the smallest possible number of black cells? Give a construction and prove it is minimal.
previous_answers.explanation: 任取两行两列的四角，每次翻0或2角，黑角数恒为偶数。若仅1—4个黑格，必有全白行和列；用任一黑格及它们围成四角，就只有1黑角，矛盾。故至少5；翻一整行恰得5。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Every rectangle formed by two rows and columns keeps an even number of black corners: a move flips zero or two. With 1–4 black cells, an all-white row and column would exist; any black cell would then define a rectangle with one black corner, impossible. Flipping one whole row attains five.

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 不断独立投掷一枚公平硬币，直到连续三次的结果首次出现HHT或HTH便停止（H为正面，T为反面）。哪一种更可能先出现？求它的概率，并说明理由。
previous_answers.headline_en: Keep tossing a fair coin independently until HHT or HTH first appears as three consecutive results (H=heads, T=tails). Which pattern is more likely to appear first? Find its probability and justify your answer.
previous_answers.result_en: HHT wins with probability 2/3; HTH with 1/3
previous_answers.explanation: 设刚出现H后HHT先出的概率为p。下一次H，则等到T必由HHT胜；下一次T，再出H则HTH胜，再出T则重回起点。因此p=1/2+p/4，得2/3。开头的T只延迟首个H，不改变胜率。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Let p be the chance that HHT wins just after H. A following H leads to an HHT win at the first T. A following T then H lets HTH win; a following T then T resets the process. Thus p=1/2+p/4, so p=2/3. Initial tails merely delay the first H.

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 从1至60中选出一些不同的整数，要求选出的数中不存在a<b<c，使b是a的整数倍且c是b的整数倍。最多能选几个？给出一组选法，并证明无法选得更多。
previous_answers.headline_en: Choose distinct integers from 1 to 60. Your set must not contain a<b<c with b a multiple of a and c a multiple of b. What is the largest possible number of selected integers? Give an example and prove optimality.
previous_answers.explanation: 按奇数部分分链u、2u、4u……，链中任取三数都违例。15条长链各至多取2数，15条单元素链各至多取1数，故至多45。取16至60共45数；若a|b|c，则c≥4a≥64，矛盾。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Group numbers into chains u,2u,4u,… for odd u. Any three from one chain are forbidden. Fifteen longer chains allow at most two selections each; fifteen singleton chains allow one, giving 45. Select 16–60. A divisibility triple would give c≥4a≥64, impossible.

challenges.headline_en: Colour a 6×6 board alternately black and white, then remove any one black square and any one white square. Can the remaining 34 squares always be tiled by seventeen 1×2 dominoes without overlap? Rotation is allowed; dominoes must stay inside the board. Give a method that works for every pair of removed squares, or a counterexample.
